items.statement: The submitted workflow verifies a converged ground-state geometry for the specified neutral singlet m-NH2 molecule and records its geometry method and conformer provenance.
items.expected: A reproducible geometry optimization is documented as converged, with identity and conformer provenance; a frequency or equivalent stability check is reported when available.

items.statement: The submitted D-index is obtained from an explicitly identified lowest singlet S0→S1 excitation, not an unspecified excited state or emission geometry.
items.expected: The report identifies the S1 root/state and shows a completed excited-state calculation tied to the optimized S0 structure and water boundary.

items.statement: Hole–electron analysis uses the same S0→S1 excitation identified in the workflow and produces a finite positive centroid separation.
items.expected: The report links the analysis artifact to the selected S1 excitation and validates a single finite positive D-index in Å.

items.statement: For m-NH2, the paper reports a D-index of 2.25 Å for the lowest singlet excitation.
items.expected: Completed submissions report a D-index numerically consistent with 2.25 Å within the evaluator tolerance; bounded-failure submissions do not fabricate a value and instead document the failed stage.
